findings.title: Overly broad IAM grant: Resource is "*"
findings.body: grant_policy grants s3:GetObject/PutObject on every resource; scope it to the bucket.

findings.title: Trust policy allows any tenant to assume the role
findings.body: The condition does not scope the principal to a tenant.

findings.title: Incorrect base64 encoding of the EncryptionContext
findings.body: The EncryptionContext is base64-encoded incorrectly and will fail to decode.

findings.title: Path traversal via tenant_id in the S3 key
findings.body: tenant_id is concatenated into the object key without sanitisation.
findings.anchor: key = sanitize(tenant_id) + name  # this line is not in the diff
